lines: Yeh aarzu thi tujhe gul ke rubaru karte
couplets.en: I wished to bring you face to face with a rose.
The restless nightingale and I would have talked.

lines: Payaambar na muyassar hua to khoob hua
couplets.en: Perhaps it was just as well I found no messenger.
How could I tell my longing in another's voice?

lines: Yeh aarzu thi tujhe gul ke rubaru karte
couplets.en: I wished to bring you face to face with a rose.

lines: Jo dekhte teri zanjeer-e-zulf ka aalam
couplets.en: If only they could see the chains your curls make.

lines: Aseer hone ki aazaad aarzu karte
couplets.en: Even the free would long to be held captive.
